holidays.name: Ignition Day
holidays.longDescription: Ignition Day is observed on day 1 of month 1 in the Void Drifters Calendar. It is classified as a civic and is associated with Year burn starts, engines lit . Communities use the occasion to preserve local memory, reinforce shared identity, and mark the passage of the calendar year. Practices vary by region and faction, so this observance may carry different political or religious meaning across the wider world.
